about: Luvia Creations brings a premium touch to handmade crochet accessories, toys, gifts and decor, thoughtfully crafted in India.
Explore the collections and individual product pages for photos, materials, dimensions and care information where provided. If a detail is missing, ask us before ordering rather than assuming.

Interested in a particular colour or a customised piece? Send the product link and your preferences. Customisation depends on the product and must be confirmed with us, including price and dispatch timing.

We ship across India. Review availability, shipping charges and the order total before payment. Online orders are confirmed after payment verification. A cart or WhatsApp message is an order request, not a confirmed purchase.
questions: How do I place an order?

Choose the product and variant, add your items to the cart, and save your contact and delivery address. When online checkout is available, review your coupon, shipping and total, then proceed to payment through Razorpay. Your order is confirmed after payment verification. Otherwise send an order request on WhatsApp or email and confirm availability and the total with Luvia before paying. Guest ordering is available; email signup is optional. Saved delivery details stay with your cart for up to 30 days and are visible to Luvia for order fulfilment. Adding items or sending a message does not confirm an order.
Can I request different colours or customisation?
Ask us on WhatsApp with the product link and your preferences. Options depend on the product; we will confirm whether the request is possible, along with any price or timing changes.
Do you ship across India, and how much does shipping cost?

We ship across India. For online checkout, shipping is free when the items subtotal after coupon discounts is at least ₹500. Below ₹500, the current saved courier estimate rounded up to the next ₹10 applies, or ₹100 if no current estimate is available. Review the shipping charge and total before you pay. Delivery time after dispatch depends on your location.
When will my order be dispatched?

Orders are dispatched within 5 days of receiving the order, or earlier. Dispatch means handing the parcel to the courier. Delivery time after dispatch depends on the destination and is not included in this dispatch window.

Use Proceed to payment in the cart when online checkout is available. Razorpay processes the payment, and Luvia confirms your order only after payment verification. For WhatsApp or email enquiries, confirm payment instructions with Luvia before sending money. Never share your card PIN, OTP or passwords in a message.
Does this website take payment or complete checkout?

Yes, when online checkout is enabled: payment is processed through Razorpay and the order is confirmed after payment verification. Adding items to a cart or contacting us on WhatsApp does not complete a purchase or take payment. Admin Razorpay test checkout is a sandbox demonstration only: no real money is charged and no order is placed.
Are taxes and shipping included in the displayed price?

Displayed product prices include GST. Shipping is additional unless explicitly stated otherwise. Confirm the selected variant, quantity and final total including shipping before paying. Variant prices can differ; the price shown for your selected variant applies.
What materials and sizes are used?
Check the individual product details for confirmed materials and dimensions. Information varies by product; ask us to confirm any missing details, suitability or sizing before ordering.
How should I care for my crochet product?
Follow the care instructions on the individual product page where provided. If instructions are missing or you are unsure, contact us before washing; care depends on the materials and construction.
